facts.text: The clone is a Python device adaptor for the ASI MS-2000-500-CP multi-axis stage controller
The constructor opens a serial port at 115200 baud with a 5 s timeout; for that baud rate DIP switches 4 and 5 must be DOWN
The controller must answer 'Version: USB-9.2k'; another version is refused by an assertion
The constructor accepts only the axis tuples ('X','Y'), ('Z',) and ('X','Y','Z')
The lead-screw table gives pitch in mm, encoder resolution in nm and maximum velocity in mm/s for UC, SC, S, F and XF
The travel range is required from the caller: axes_min_mm and axes_max_mm become min_position_um and max_position_um in micrometres
The upstream default encoder resolution is 10 counts per micrometre and can be overridden at construction
_get_position returns the axis positions in micrometres, computed as encoder counts divided by the configured counts per micrometre
move_um takes target positions in micrometres, checks them against the configured min_position_um and max_position_um, and rounds them to 0.001 um
The motor-moving query reports False only when the controller answers 'N'
get_pwm_intensity reads the LED X value as an integer percent
set_pwm_intensity accepts an integer from 1 to 99
set_pwm_state accepts off, on, pwm and external
The TTL input mode code is 0 for disabled and 10 for toggle_ttl_out; the TTL output mode code is 0 for low, 1 for high and 9 for pwm
set_pwm_state programs off as disabled/low, on as disabled/high, pwm as disabled/pwm and external as toggle_ttl_out/low
close turns the PWM output off before it closes the serial port
The README warns that the test block moves the XY and Z stages and asks to remove samples and the objective before testing
The README says MS-2000 controllers come in many variants that can connect different devices, so the attached hardware is configuration data

The README says the adaptor was tested with an MS-2000-500-CP at firmware USB-9.2k, an MS-2000 flat top XY stage with standard lead screws, an LS-50 Z stage with a fine lead screw and an ASI PWM transmitted light LED
